facts.text: Snow left Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) 41 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: left April 28; earlier seasons: June 14 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 5 (2025)

facts.text: At Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 6.4 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: 6.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 45.8 in (2023), 37.0 in (2024), 45.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 6 and May 7, carried from the melt-out date at Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) to the pass elevation.
